title: Instantaneous power expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly expressed as P = F²t₁/m.

title: Average power expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly expressed as P_avg = F²t₁/(2m).

title: Apply Newton's second law
description: Important: The solution must correctly use F=ma to find the constant acceleration a = F/m.

title: Kinematics for velocity
description: Important: The solution must correctly find the velocity at time t₁ using v₁ = a t₁ = (F/m)t₁.

title: Define instantaneous power
description: Important: The solution must correctly define instantaneous power as P = F * v (dot product, scalar for 1D).

title: Define average power
description: Important: The solution must correctly define average power as total work divided by time, or use P_avg = F * v_avg for constant force.

title: Average velocity for constant acceleration
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly state or use the relation v_avg = (v_initial + v_final)/2 = v₁/2.

title: Incorrect power formula
description: Pitfall: Using P = F * a or P = m a v instead of P = F * v for instantaneous power.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Omitting units (Watts) or making a sign error in the vector dot product for power.
